text: The swarm starts soon. Read swarm/GOAL.md and swarm/README.md on integration.

Checks for P01 P02 P03 P08 P10 P13 are on integration. Run npm run milestones. GOAL.md now says: every command (measure, guards, proposer, run, compare) runs in the problem folder inside the scratch checkout, and every path is relative to the problem folder. P13 now needs P16.

Checks for P04 P05 P06 P07 P11 P12 are on integration too: 12 of 17 milestones now have checks. GOAL.md adds a top-level 'candidates' field (default 1), says two runs are the same problem when they have the same name in the same repository, and says '-20' is -20.
